runningPayloadBasis: Bumpers 6.0-7.5 kg, battery and leads 5.0-6.9 kg and 24 FUEL at 0.203-0.227 kg: all carried in the match but outside the R103 weighing

masses.basis: Four 2x1x0.125 in 6061 rails (2.72 m at 1.20 kg/m), 3 mm polycarbonate floor (about 0.4 m2), slide rails, tube mounts, gussets, and the 3 mm aluminum lane deck (0.33 kg as drawn). The front lip of the earlier issue is removed

Two side walls and the rear wall (drawn 3 mm) and two formed liners and the battery shelf panel (drawn 2 mm), all allocated as 1.5 mm polycarbonate: 1.73 kg of walls and 1.12 kg of liners at 1.2 g/cm3, plus 0.3-0.6 kg of edge stiffeners and fasteners and 10% high. The front upper wall of the earlier issue is removed

Four MAXSwerve corners: 1.720 kg purchased assembly each (foundation reconciliation), 6.88 kg, plus four drive motors at 0.43 kg and four steering motors at 0.14 kg, 2.28 kg; 0.25 kg low for the lighter wheel option and 0.5 kg high for fasteners and encoders cables
Two flat belt runs 332 mm wide in the channel, rollers, one motor and gearbox
Two 2 in compliant rollers on 12 mm shafts (0.30-0.40 kg each), two planetary gearmotors with brakes (0.25-0.40 kg each), bearing blocks 0.1 kg

Flywheel as built in dimensions.py: 2.56 kg for 0.0076 kg m2 (aluminum tube roller 0.80 kg, tread 0.45 kg, one steel inertia ring 0.97 kg on a 0.09 kg web, hubs 0.25 kg), plus 5% high. Two side plates allocated as 4.76 mm aluminum with 30 to 50% pocketed out, 0.91-1.28 kg (the drawn 8 mm envelopes would weigh 3.06 kg solid). Hood 0.75 kg. Two flywheel motors 0.9-1.2 kg. Shaft, bearings and fasteners 0.3-0.6 kg

Vertical belt module with internal motor and top roller as in the earlier issue (2.8-3.6 kg), 130 mm more belt and frame (0.25-0.4 kg), the back plate as a folded 1 mm aluminum wedge (0.4-0.6 kg), and two carriage plates allocated as 3 mm aluminum with 25 to 40% pocketed out, 0.79-0.98 kg (the drawn 10 mm envelopes would weigh 4.36 kg solid)
Two telescoping tube pairs, hooks with swing actuators inside the inner tubes, winch and cables
Power distribution, controller, radio, 17 motor controllers, breaker, three beam sensors, wiring on the panels under the right shelf and in the right bay
R103 excludes bumpers; 6.0-7.5 kg carried in the running payload and in the R408 check
R103 excludes the battery and its connector half; 5.0-6.9 kg (V0 battery 4.99-6.57 kg plus leads) carried in the running payload
HUB and TOWER references are field equipment

Fasteners, brackets, cable chain, camera and spares not yet drawn. The upper bound falls 0.5 kg from the earlier issue: the feeder mounts, battery strap, lane deck and liner joints it covered are now drawn and weighed in their own lines
Two cleat envelopes, 74.5 cm3: high as solid 6061 at 2.70 g/cm3, low at half fill for formed angle; rivets inside. Webbing strap and buckle 0.05-0.10 kg

intake-deploy-nominal.basis: Simultaneous battery-side bounds for the intake-deploy duty with supply current limits (drive 25 A per module battery-side)

intake-deploy-weak.basis: Simultaneous battery-side bounds for the intake-deploy duty with supply current limits (drive 25 A per module battery-side)

acquire-1-nominal.basis: Simultaneous battery-side bounds for the acquire duty with supply current limits (drive 25 A per module battery-side). The intake row is its 30 A supply limit: with three FUEL abreast on a 9 V bus the driven belt draws 30 A and its speed dips to 2.13 m/s, and all three are captured. The flywheel row holds the wheel at speed while FUEL is aboard

loaded-transit-nominal.basis: Simultaneous battery-side bounds for the loaded-transit duty with supply current limits (drive 25 A per module battery-side). The flywheel row covers a spin-up from rest during the transit at 15 A per motor: 1.9 s on the weak pack (30 A battery-side peak)

loaded-transit-weak.basis: Simultaneous battery-side bounds for the loaded-transit duty with supply current limits (drive 25 A per module battery-side). The flywheel row covers a spin-up from rest during the transit at 15 A per motor: 1.9 s on the weak pack (30 A battery-side peak)

launch-1-nominal.basis: Simultaneous battery-side bounds for the launch duty with supply current limits (drive 25 A per module battery-side). The flywheel row is two motors at their 30 A supply limit: the weak-pack batch trial peaks at 55 A battery-side. One shot takes 17 J from the wheel, a 1.9% speed fall that the motors return before the next feed. The indexer row is the floor belt and both feeder gearmotors
